steps.title: Loan Terms & Tenure Selection
steps.action: User adjusts desired amount slider and repayment tenure
steps.response: Calculates monthly EMI and prompts 'Apply Now'

steps.title: Step 1: PAN & Employment Information
steps.action: User enters PAN card, work status, and employer details
steps.response: Validates PAN format via NSDL API; advances to Step 2

steps.title: Step 2: Financial KYC & Bank Account
steps.action: User provides monthly income and salary bank IFSC details
steps.response: Dispatches encrypted payload to underwriting engine

steps.title: Automated Underwriting Review Queue
steps.action: System executes algorithmic risk assessment and bureau check
steps.response: Routes user to either Approved or Declined outcome state

steps.title: Outcome Decision
steps.action: Presents decision: ₹1,50,000 Sanctioned or Declined with alternatives
steps.response: Borrower accepts disbursement or views credit-building options
